headline: Oando Posts N74.65 Billion Pre-Tax Loss in 9M 2026 on High Finance Costs
summary: Oando Plc recorded a pre-tax loss of N74.65 billion for the first nine months of 2026, compared to a pre-tax profit of N19.46 billion a year earlier, as net finance costs surged to N235.23 billion.
why: Energy company earnings reports reveal the impact of debt servicing costs and currency fluctuations on corporate profitability in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Oando Plc
impacts.why: A significant pre-tax loss driven by soaring finance costs indicates financial pressure for the energy firm.
